plan:
I'm on a spot-price electricity contract. Please schedule these appliance cycles for 2022-05-18 so that my electricity cost is as low as possible, without exceeding my household peak load limit:
- dishwasher (dishwasher_1): ready from 07:00, must finish by 19:15
- washing machine (washing_machine_1): ready from 10:00, must finish by 18:15

results.label: Multi-Agent Pipeline
results.message: Your appliances are scheduled to run at the same time for optimal efficiency! The dishwasher will start at 15:00 and finish by 15:30, while the washing machine will also start at 15:00 and finish by 16:15. The estimated cost for this schedule is low, and it comfortably stays within your household peak load limit. Enjoy your clean dishes and laundry!
